name: Open a problem from an incident cluster
intent: Create a problem that actually links the cluster rather than a duplicate empty problem.

incident_numbers.description: One or more incident numbers to cluster into a problem

procedure: Input: one or more incident numbers. Load them; abort if they do not share a plausible CI or symptom.
Draft problem: short_description from the cluster, cmdb_ci from majority CI, first_reported_by_task = oldest incident.
On confirm, insert problem and set incident.problem_id on each. Work note on each incident.
Do not set known_error or workaround in this skill; that is a later update.
sideEffects: inserts a problem and links each incident via problem_id; adds work notes to the incidents

prompts: Open a problem for INC0012345 and INC0012346.
These three incidents look related, create a problem.
Cluster INC0012345 into a problem record.
